title: Cross-Check Insight 2026, Edition 3
summary: Welcome to Cross-Check, Marsh’s quarterly aviation report that brings together the unparalleled capabilities of our global operating companies.
body_markdown:
##


Cross-Check is Marsh’s quarterly Aviation-focused publication designed to provide aviation leaders with comprehensive insights that address the full spectrum of aviation industry challenges – from operational risk and safety to market trends and strategic foresight.


##


Cross-Check is intended for aviation leaders, risk managers, insurance buyers, operational leaders, and decision makers who want clear perspectives on aviation risks and market conditions.


##


Cross-Check covers a range of aviation issues, including market trends, safety management, operational risk, cyber exposure, insurer appetite, and supply chain constraints.


##


A total system approach examines the full aviation ecosystem to help understand how risk is created and amplified across airlines, airports, supplied and other industry partners.


##


The report offers timely, actionable insights to help leaders better assess risk, strengthen resilience, and plan with confidence.
